assertion: An event exists, described as "Louvre jewellery heist".
judge_quote: Everything we know about the Louvre jewellery heist
evidence_cited: The Louvre Museum in Paris is still closed on Monday while police investigate a brazen heist which targeted France's priceless crown jewels. || Thieves wielding power tools broke into the world's most visited museum in broad daylight, before escaping on scooters with eight extremely valuable items of jewellery.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Police investigation".
judge_quote: The Louvre Museum in Paris is still closed on Monday while police investigate a brazen heist which targeted France's priceless crown jewels.
evidence_cited: The Louvre Museum in Paris is still closed on Monday while police investigate a brazen heist which targeted France's priceless crown jewels. || Around 60 investigators are working on the case and prosecutors said their theory is that the robbers were under orders for a criminal organisation.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Escape on scooters".
judge_quote: French police say the thieves were inside for four minutes and made their escape on two scooters waiting outside at 09:38.
evidence_cited: Thieves wielding power tools broke into the world's most visited museum in broad daylight, before escaping on scooters with eight extremely valuable items of jewellery. || French police say the thieves were inside for four minutes and made their escape on two scooters waiting outside at 09:38.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Museum evacuation".
judge_quote: They then threatened the guards, who evacuated the premises
evidence_cited: They then threatened the guards, who evacuated the premises, and cut through the glass of two display cases containing jewels. || One witness described scenes of "total panic" as the museum was evacuated.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Alarm malfunction".
judge_quote: Goulet told the BBC the gallery's localised alarm was recently broken
evidence_cited: Goulet told the BBC the gallery's localised alarm was recently broken, and "we have to wait for the investigation in order to know if the alarm was disactivated". || France's culture ministry said the museum's wider alarms did sound and staff followed protocol by contacting security forces and protecting visitors.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Attempted vehicle fire".
judge_quote: The gang had tried to set fire to their vehicle outside but were prevented by the intervention of a museum staff-member
evidence_cited: The gang had tried to set fire to their vehicle outside but were prevented by the intervention of a museum staff-member, the culture ministry added.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Recovery of crown".
judge_quote: Empress Eugénie's crown was found damaged on the escape route, investigators said, apparently having been dropped during the escape.
evidence_cited: Empress Eugénie's crown was found damaged on the escape route, investigators said, apparently having been dropped during the escape.

assertion: An event exists, described as "New Renaissance project".
judge_quote: At the time, French President Emmanuel Macron pledged the Louvre would be redesigned as part of the New Renaissance project
evidence_cited: At the time, French President Emmanuel Macron pledged the Louvre would be redesigned as part of the New Renaissance project - expected to cost between €700 million and €800 million (£ 608m - £695m; $816m - $933m).

assertion: An event exists, described as "Political outcry".
judge_quote: The theft has caused a political outcry in France, with Macron calling the raid "an attack on our history", National Rally leader Jordan Bardella said it was a "intolerable humiliation" and Marine Le Pen of Front Nationale called it a "wound to the French soul".
evidence_cited: The theft has caused a political outcry in France, with Macron calling the raid "an attack on our history", National Rally leader Jordan Bardella said it was a "intolerable humiliation" and Marine Le Pen of Front Nationale called it a "wound to the French soul".

assertion: An event exists, described as "Mona Lisa theft".
judge_quote: In 1911, an Italian museum employee was able to make off with the Mona Lisa under his coat after lifting the painting
evidence_cited: In 1911, an Italian museum employee was able to make off with the Mona Lisa under his coat after lifting the painting - which was then little-known to the public - straight off the wall of a quiet gallery.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Le Chemin de Sevres theft".
judge_quote: In 1998, the Le Chemin de Sevres - a 19th century painting by Camille Corot - was stolen and has never been found.
evidence_cited: In 1998, the Le Chemin de Sevres - a 19th century painting by Camille Corot - was stolen and has never been found.

assertion: An event exists, described as "Adrien Dubouche theft".
